items.exampleEn: She always has a positive attitude at work.
items.exampleZh: 她工作時總是抱持正面的態度。

items.exampleEn: The new rule has been very effective in reducing noise.
items.exampleZh: 新規定在減少噪音上非常有效。

items.exampleEn: She looked directly at me and smiled.
There is a strange object on the table.
items.exampleZh: 桌上有一個奇怪的東西。

items.exampleEn: The menu offers a wide variety of dishes.
items.exampleZh: 菜單上有各式各樣的菜。

items.exampleEn: I generally get up at seven.
Trust is an important element of friendship.
items.exampleZh: 信任是友誼中很重要的元素。

items.exampleEn: Obviously, he forgot about our meeting.
items.exampleZh: 很明顯，他忘了我們的會議。

items.sentenceEn: Exercise is an effective way to reduce stress.
items.sentenceZh: 運動是減輕壓力的有效方法。

items.audioEn: You can call the manager directly. Her number is on the card.
items.audioZh: 你可以直接打電話給經理，她的號碼在名片上。

items.sentenceEn: Obviously, nobody wants to work on a holiday.
items.sentenceZh: 很顯然，沒有人想在假日上班。

items.sentenceEn: Try to stay positive, even on a bad day.
items.sentenceZh: 即使日子不順，也要試著保持正面。

items.stemEn: The bus goes ____ to the museum, so you don't need to change.
items.stemZh: 這班公車直達博物館，所以你不用換車。

items.stemEn: Fresh fish is a key ____ of Japanese cooking.
items.stemZh: 新鮮的魚是日本料理的關鍵元素。

items.passageEn: Our English class has tried a new way of learning. Instead of reading from books, we generally learn by talking about objects in the room. The teacher brings a variety of things, like old cameras and toys. Each student must stand up and describe one object to the class. This method is obviously effective: everyone speaks more than before. Another positive element is that the class is never dull.
items.passageZh: 我們的英文課試了一種新的學習方式。我們通常不是讀課本，而是靠談論教室裡的物品來學習。老師會帶各式各樣的東西來，例如舊相機和玩具。每個學生都必須站起來，向全班描述一樣物品。這個方法顯然很有效：每個人都說得比以前多。另一個正面的因素是，上課從來不會無聊。

questions.questionZh: 這堂英文課的新方法是什麼？
為什麼說這個方法很有效？
options: 每個人都說得比以前多

items.promptZh: 這個方法很有效，但是很花時間。
referenceEn: This method is effective, but it takes a lot of time.
This way is very effective, but it takes a long time.
rubricZh: effective 表示「有效的」，可放在 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 is effective、an effective way）
「很花時間」可寫 take a lot of time、take a long time 等
例如用 but 連接兩句，其他合理寫法也接受

items.promptZh: 大部分關於新菜單的意見都是正面的。
referenceEn: Most of the comments about the new menu were positive.
Most comments on the new menu were positive.
rubricZh: 用 positive 表示「正面的」（例如 were positive）
「意見」可寫，例如 comments、opinions 等；時態可用 were、are 等
